children: Choice Institutional Equities's report on ESDS Software Solutions

India’s underpenetrated cloud market offers a durable growth runway, with AI adding a higher-growth layer. India’s cloud market is expected to grow at a 23.6% CAGR through FY25 from INR 651 Bn to INR 1.9 Tn in FY30, supported by enterprise digitisation, BFSI adoption and rising government workloads. Increasing data-residency and compliance requirements further favour domestic infrastructure providers, where ESDS has established credentials and diversified exposure across Enterprise (55.1%), Government (27.4%) and BFSI (17.5%). Beyond the core opportunity, India’s cloud GPU market is projected to grow at ~50% CAGR through FY30, expanding ESDS’s addressable market into GPUaaS, GPU colocation and AI-led managed infrastructure.
We initiate coverage on ESDS with a ‘BUY’ rating and a TP of INR 1,550, valuing the company at 18x FY28E EV/EBITDA, with a DCF used as a sanity check.
